title: issue62424/fix62607 DDL implicit commit leaves stale transaction state trusted by GC

payload.user_symptom: BEGIN followed by a large CREATE INDEX can leave GC safepoint blocked because the DDL session's stale CurTxnStartTS is treated as an active transaction startTS.
payload.issue_signal: issue 62424 notes DDL implicitly commits the previous transaction, but SetProcessInfo leaves curTxnStartTs visible; ReportMinStartTS then uses it as minStartTS and blocks GC
payload.expected_next_step: execute upstream TestDDLInsideTXNNotBlockMinStartTS across vulnerable/fixed revisions or an equivalent root-boundary oracle that holds DDL in queue and checks ReportMinStartTS ignores the DDL session

provenance.source: issue 62424 metadata plus fix PR 62607 diff

name: GC minStartTS observer over DDL session state

state_model: session.SetProcessInfo writes ProcessInfo.CurTxnStartTS from SessionVars.TxnCtx.StartTS for running statements and in-transaction sessions
DDL execution calls sessiontxn.NewTxnInStmt and enqueues a DDL job; once the DDL job is in storage queue, StmtCtx.IsDDLJobInQueue is true
InfoSyncer.ReportMinStartTS reads SessionManager.ShowProcessList and uses each ProcessInfo.CurTxnStartTS to compute this server's minStartTS
GC worker consumes reported minStartTS to avoid advancing safepoint past active readers/transactions
fix 62607 skips processlist entries whose StmtCtx.IsDDLJobInQueue is true, so DDL sessions do not pin minStartTS after implicit commit
side_effects: DDL implicit commit clears the user transaction contract but not necessarily the processlist-visible CurTxnStartTS during statement execution
long DDL stays visible in processlist while the job is queued/executing
minStartTS can be pinned to a stale transaction startTS and delay GC progress
harness_capabilities: testkit can create mock store/domain and call dom.InfoSyncer().ReportMinStartTS(store,nil) directly
DDL mockDMLExecution/failpoint can hold ALTER TABLE ADD INDEX after the job is queued
a second real transaction can provide the expected active minStartTS control
upstream TestDDLInsideTXNNotBlockMinStartTS is a deterministic root-boundary oracle

name: DDL queued session must not pin GC minStartTS after implicit commit

payload.p_check: ReportMinStartTS sees a processlist entry with CurTxnStartTS and assumes it represents an active transaction or detached reader that GC must protect.
payload.q_claim: A DDL statement that has already been enqueued after implicit commit is no longer an active user transaction, so its stale CurTxnStartTS must not lower the reported minStartTS.

boundary.before: session begins a transaction, then executes ALTER/CREATE INDEX; DDL performs implicit commit and the DDL job enters the storage queue
boundary.fault: ProcessInfo.CurTxnStartTS from the pre-DDL transaction remains visible while StmtCtx.IsDDLJobInQueue is true
boundary.after: InfoSyncer.ReportMinStartTS scans ShowProcessList and chooses the minimum startTS to report for GC

source_anchors: issue 62424 shows SetProcessInfo keeps curTxnStartTS when command is not ComSleep or session is in transaction
pkg/session/session.go SetProcessInfo copies SessionVars.TxnCtx.StartTS into ProcessInfo.CurTxnStartTS
pkg/domain/infosync/info.go ReportMinStartTS scans ShowProcessList and compares info.CurTxnStartTS before fix
pkg/ddl/executor.go sets sessVars.StmtCtx.IsDDLJobInQueue=true after the DDL job is submitted
fix 62607 pkg/domain/infosync/info.go skips entries whose StmtCtx.IsDDLJobInQueue is true
fix 62607 integration test holds ADD INDEX and expects minStartTS to be the second active transaction's startTS, not the DDL session's older startTS
side_effects: GC safepoint progress is artificially delayed
stale processlist transaction state outlives the actual transaction contract
a long DDL can make cluster GC appear blocked
consumers: long DDL jobs executed inside transaction context
payload.consequence: GC can be pinned by a stale DDL session startTS even though no user transaction needs that timestamp; this is an availability/space-retention correctness bug
payload.experiment_need: hold a DDL job after it enters queue, create a later active transaction as control, call ReportMinStartTS, and assert the reported minStartTS equals the active transaction startTS rather than the older DDL session startTS

provenance.source: issue 62424 symptom and fix 62607 source diff

name: Hold queued DDL with stale CurTxnStartTS while GC observes minStartTS

payload.source_anchor: pkg/domain/infosync/info.go ReportMinStartTS processlist scan plus pkg/ddl/executor.go IsDDLJobInQueue marking

trigger_condition.phase: after DDL job has been submitted and StmtCtx.IsDDLJobInQueue is true, before the DDL statement returns
trigger_condition.operation: BEGIN; ALTER TABLE ... ADD INDEX on a table large or held long enough to observe processlist

observe: DDL session has an older CurTxnStartTS from the pre-DDL transaction
a second active transaction has a later StartTS and should be the minStartTS control
vulnerable ReportMinStartTS chooses the older DDL startTS
fixed ReportMinStartTS ignores the queued DDL session and chooses the later active transaction startTS
full cluster lift should show GC safepoint is not pinned by the DDL session
payload.red_signature: reported minStartTS equals the stale DDL session startTS while DDL is queued
payload.green_signature: reported minStartTS skips the DDL session and equals the later active transaction's startTS
payload.cleanup: release DDL hold/failpoint, wait for DDL to finish, rollback or commit control transaction, drop test table/index

provenance.source: issue 62424 reproduce idea and fix 62607 integration test

rationale: the bug is a DDL implicit commit path leaving transaction-visible state that GC still trusts
the broad oracle is that DDL implicit commit must not leave stale transaction state trusted by downstream observers
the scenario is DDL executed after BEGIN with GC/processlist observer
the schedule captures startTS before DDL, runs DDL implicit commit, then observes GC/process state
the observation must land after DDL is queued and before the stale processlist state disappears
